title: Gateway route-to-validator names are pinned by authorization coverage tests
answers: test_gateway_guardrail_gating fails after renaming gateway validators
which validator guards the guardrail add or remove endpoint route
how do I rename a gateway auth validator without breaking tests
body:
Convention: each gateway endpoint-attached route (add-to-endpoint, remove-from-endpoint, update-config, list-for-endpoint) is mapped to a route-specific validator, and tests/server/auth/test_authorization_coverage.py:test_gateway_guardrail_gating asserts the exact validator name per route.
Renaming or splitting a validator in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py therefore requires updating those assertions in the same change, or the test fails deterministically.
Current mapping: add -> validate_can_add_guardrail_to_gateway_endpoint, remove -> validate_can_remove_guardrail_from_gateway_endpoint, update-config -> validate_can_update_gateway_endpoint_guardrail_config, list-for-endpoint -> validate_can_read_gateway_endpoint_guardrail_configs.
applies: Gateway guardrail and endpoint-attached routes registered in the auth before-request validator map.
says: Update access permissions for attaching guardrails to an AI Gateway endpoint.
Restrict which team members can remove guardrails from a gateway endpoint.
Change authorization requirements for editing gateway endpoint guardrail configurations.
Control user permissions for viewing guardrails attached to a gateway endpoint.
Split permission checks for managing guardrails on AI Gateway endpoints.
